title: Riverbend HIM Fee Schedule: Third-Party Release Charges, Prepayment and Unpaid Fee Closing — Medical Records Request (Release of Information)
content:
Riverbend Regional Health's release schedule for authorized third-party releases under the Medical Records Request (Release of Information) product, together with the prepayment and unpaid-fee closing settings of each request type.

## Third-party release charges

These figures are the same under all seven request types — Patient Access - Electronic Copy, Patient Access - Paper Copy, Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party, Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative, Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier, Amendment of Health Record Request and Accounting of Disclosures Request.

| Charge | What it is | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| Retrieval fee | the retrieval fee per authorized third-party release | $20.00 per release |
| Certification fee | the fee to certify a copy for a third party who asks for certification | $8.00 |
| Imaging fee | the fee per imaging study copied to media for a third party | $10.00 per imaging study |

### Per-page ladder for third-party paper or PDF copies

Each band's per-page fee applies to the pages that fall within that band; the pages of a copy are run through the bands in order, from page 1 upward.

| Pages within the band | Per-page fee |
|---|---|
| pages 1 through 25 | $1.00 |
| pages 26 through 50 | $0.75 |
| pages 51 through 100 | $0.50 |
| page 101 and every page above it | $0.30 |

**Ladder worked on hypothetical page counts.**

- A hypothetical 25-page copy sits wholly in the first band: 25 pages at $1.00 each, $25.00.
- A hypothetical 26-page copy: 25 pages at $1.00 come to $25.00, and the 26th page falls in the second band at $0.75, for $25.75 in all.
- A hypothetical 120-page copy: pages 1 through 25 at $1.00 come to $25.00; pages 26 through 50, which are 25 pages at $0.75, come to $18.75; pages 51 through 100, which are 50 pages at $0.50, come to $25.00; pages 101 through 120, which are 20 pages at $0.30, come to $6.00. The ladder charge is the total of the four bands, $74.75.

## Prepayment and unpaid-fee closing, by request type

Column meanings:

- **Prepayment required**: whether fees are paid before release.
- **Unpaid fee closing period**: the number of calendar days an unpaid third-party fee stays open before the request closes unfulfilled.

| Request type | Prepayment required | Unpaid fee closing period (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Patient Access - Electronic Copy | No | 0 |
| Patient Access - Paper Copy | No | 0 |
| Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party | No | 0 |
| Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative | Yes | 60 |
| Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier | Yes | 60 |
| Amendment of Health Record Request | No | 0 |
| Accounting of Disclosures Request | Yes | 60 |
